business: Nora Furnish (norafurnish.com), an online store for modern and statement lighting and home decor
target: US homeowners, 28 to 60, buying statement or replacement lighting ($150 to $1,000 a fixture) online for a renovation, a new home or a room refresh

segments.name: Trade buyer (interior designer, contractor or short-term-rental host)

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Will not buy from a store without reviews, Trustpilot or a track record; checks 'is X legit' before paying.

behaviours.name: Price checker
behaviours.how: Screenshots products and runs them through Google Lens or searches Amazon, Wayfair and AliExpress for the same item before buying.

behaviours.name: Big-retailer loyalist
behaviours.how: Buys lighting from Wayfair, Amazon, Lowe's, Lumens or West Elm because returns and delivery are known.

behaviours.name: Pinterest and Instagram saver
behaviours.how: Saves statement pieces from social feeds for months and buys when a room comes together.

behaviours.name: Spec-driven project planner
behaviours.how: Needs exact dimensions, lumens, colour temperature, UL listing and install details for the electrician; buys a room at a time.

behaviours.name: Deadline buyer
behaviours.how: Has a move-in, listing or electrician date and needs fixtures in hand within a week or two.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Waits for sales and promo codes and compares totals across stores.

objections: I've never heard of this store, is it legit?
I can probably find the same light cheaper on Amazon or AliExpress
10 to 12 business days is a long wait for a light
Is it UL listed and safe, and will my electrician install it?
Return shipping on a big fixture would cost me a fortune
I can't judge the quality from photos
$300 for a light from a brand nobody knows is a lot
habits: you are halfway through redoing your kitchen and the electrician comes back in three weeks
you just closed on a house and every room has builder-grade flush mounts
you have a Pinterest board called 'dining room' with 40 pendant lights on it
you manage two Airbnb units and refresh them every winter
you order most things on Amazon Prime
you spent last weekend at a lighting showroom and left without buying
